entries.title: A network block no longer asks you to sign in to Claude again
entries.body: When a firewall or network block page answered a Claude request, the app took it as a lost sign-in: it paused every Claude crewmate and asked you to sign in again. Now only a refused sign-in does that. A block page is an ordinary failed turn, and the crewmate tries again on its own.
entries.noPicture: The fix removes a wrong pause and sign-in card; no view or control changes.
